ازدحموا (form VIII)
# اِزْدَحَمُوا (izdaḥamū) /iz.da.ħa.muː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِزْدَحَمَ (izdaḥama)
# اِزْدَحِمُوا (izdaḥimū) /iz.da.ħi.muː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِزْدَحَمَ (izdaḥama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
